description:
This is a plan, titled "Diagram 1 Boundaries in this Approved Document," showing three building footprints arranged side by side in grey. The middle footprint is labelled "Building"; each has an internal line drawing. The three are divided by two vertical boundary lines, the left one marked B at its top and A at its base, the right one marked E at its top and F at its base. Above the buildings runs a horizontal grey band containing the letters C and D, with a dashed white line through its centre; an arrow points to it from the text "Canal, river, railway or right of way, such as a path or street."

Beneath the plan is a table headed "The boundary for the purposes of:". The first row reads "Paragraph 1.52 Diagram 34 and 41" alongside "is ACDF". The second row reads "Paragraphs 5.1, 5.15, 5.16 and 5.18 Diagram 43 Tables 9 and 10" alongside "is ABEF".
